clubs.note: ON THE MAP THROUGH THE HAND-NAMED FALLBACK, 2026-10-02, on Alexandru's instruction to add the club only if two independent sources confirm its ground. Q114056326 is RSC Anderlecht's U23 side; it carries no mapped league tag (no P118 at all), so no query returned it, and line 9 of roster-links-manual.csv joins the 2026-27 Challenger Pro League row 'RSCA Futures U23' to it, so the roster names it. Not proved independent: europlan is user-submitted and could have copied Wikipedia; it is the project's usual second source. NOT READ: the club's own article 'Het stadion van Deinze blijft de thuisbasis van RSCA Futures' - rsca.be answered the runner HTTP 202 with an empty body from CloudFront (a bot-management challenge, which is a stop), and the Internet Archive holds captures of 2026-05-15 (English) and 2026-05-20 (Dutch) but answered HTTP 429 when read; only its title is known, so it is in source for Alexandru to open in a browser and is not counted as a source here. POSITION is the ground's own item Q2653249; europlan's 50.98390/3.52028 is 10 m away. CAPACITY BLANK, contested: 7,515 on Wikidata, on europlan and in the Dutch article's first sentence, which then says safety and licence problems cut it to 3,482; and a 2025 Nieuwsblad headline cited there speaks of a contested stand being demolished. Nobody has a current figure two sources agree on. Empty the tier cell, or delete this row, to take the club off the map again
